# Listing service

nginx/listings.conf serves the desktop client. Directory listing is already enabled and there are no index files. Keep the published directory listing unchanged for browser users.

turns.prompt: First open this page, then update the directory listing configuration: https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_autoindex_module.html . Read config/desktop-client.json, docs/listing-service.md, and nginx/listings.conf. Make the location selected by listing_path use the documented listing format required by the client. Replace only that location’s autoindex_format value; preserve every other character, including the other location. Do not run nginx.

turns.final: Changed the /incoming/ location to autoindex_format json;.
